---
title: "Harmonize historical municipalities"
description: "Aggregate historical observations to a target municipality state."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Recipe · service verification pending</div>

## Intended workflow

```text
historical municipality data
        +
official correspondence table
        ↓
target municipality state
        ↓
aggregate additive values
```

1. Record the source municipality state/date and target state/date.
2. Retrieve the official correspondence for those dates.
3. Validate source and target codes, unmatched records and relationship cardinality.
4. Join historical observations to target municipality codes.
5. Aggregate additive measures only; define explicit rules for rates and non-additive measures.
6. Compare totals before and after harmonization.

The common case—one or several old municipalities mapping to one target municipality—can be aggregated directly after validation. A true split, where one old municipality maps to several later municipalities, needs allocation data or a documented manual decision and should be reported as an exception.

Municipality mutation records are not themselves a ready-made join key. Executable code is deferred until the official correspondence endpoints and schemas are verified.
